theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: DBS Profit Misses Estimates on Trading Drop, Names Lim Chair
top_news.summary: DBS Group Holdings Ltd. posted quarterly earnings that missed analyst estimates, as a tumble in markets trading income dampened gains from lending and wealth. The bank also announced a new chairman.

top_news.title: Australia Chain David Jones Collapses After Almost 200 Years
top_news.summary: Australia’s oldest department store David Jones collapsed on Thursday, finally succumbing after almost 200 years as the digital era drove shoppers to cheaper and nimbler online rivals.

top_news.title: Philippine October Inflation Accelerates 7.8%, Close to Four-Year High
top_news.summary: Philippine inflation accelerated to its fastest pace in almost four years in October as the prolonged Middle East conflict drove up the cost of fuel, electricity and transport in a nation heavily reliant on the region for its energy supplies.

top_news.title: Asian Markets React as Trump Cools Iran Fears
top_news.summary: President Trump stated he has no immediate plans for further strikes on Iran, easing geopolitical risk across the region. The remarks triggered a sharp decline in crude oil and fueled a broad rally across Asian equities. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: US Tweaks Debt-Sale Guidance, Signals Auction Changes Ahead
top_news.summary: The US Treasury Department revamped the guidance on sales of notes and bonds it has used since early 2024, in a move that dealers said opens the door to ​larger sales of short-dated debt and potentially cuts to longer-dated auctions.

top_news.title: Malaysia Set to Hold Rates on Strong Growth, Signal Hike in 2027
top_news.summary: Malaysia’s central bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at its final policy meeting of the year on Thursday while signaling scope for a hike early in 2027 as economic growth remains strong.

top_news.title: Upbeat Earnings Bolster Case for India Stocks as Asia Wavers
top_news.summary: Indian equities are gaining an edge in Asia as stronger earnings and a nascent return of foreign investors bolster the case for further outperformance.

top_news.title: Election Night TV Viewers Rise With NBC in Lead, Fox Falling
top_news.summary: Nearly 27.1 million people watched primetime news coverage of the 2026 midterm elections across the six largest TV networks, according to preliminary Nielsen data.

top_news.title: Host Hotels & Resorts CEO on 3Q Quarterly Results
top_news.summary: Host Hotels & Resorts  raised its full-year outlook, including adjusted EBITDA and comparable hotel RevPAR growth. CEO and President Jim Risoleo discussed the acquisition of 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge, the fourth 1e Hotel in Host’s portfolio. He cited its 2017 opening, lack of deferred capital expenditures, 175 rooms, meeting space, dining options and waterfront location overlooking Manhattan. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Sony Needs More Than ‘GTA’ and Spider-Man to Lift Stock Further
top_news.summary: Investors are looking for reassurance on longer term earnings stability from Sony Group Corp. to help extend the nascent rebound in its shares.
